trigger.description: Certificate list/show/verify is invoked with no manifest path and either no database path/workspace id or an unreadable database. Previously these surfaces emitted an apparently successful empty list / not_found result that was indistinguishable from an honestly empty store; this code distinguishes 'we could not check' from 'we checked and found nothing'.
setup_commands: # invoke ee certificate list/show/verify without a manifest and without a configured workspace database

message_contains: Certificate store could not be inspected
